prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis (or anywhere) — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit. To get you started, here’s a short framework and practical next steps.

Why “best” is subjective
- Different agencies specialize: SEO, paid search (PPC), social ads, creative/brand, B2B demand gen, e‑commerce, web development, etc.
- Size/price matters: small boutique shops are good for hands‑on strategy; larger agencies give broader services and scale.
- Industry experience and measurable results are often more important than awards.

Quick selection checklist
- Clear KPIs and case studies showing similar results
- Industry experience (or a clearly transferable approach)
- Transparent reporting and measurement (monthly dashboards, conversion tracking)
- Team structure and single point of contact
- Pricing model (retainer, project, performance) and minimum contract length
- References you can call

Typical agency types and when to use them
- SEO/Content specialists — prioritize if organic growth and content are primary goals.
- PPC/Performance agencies — for fast lead/customer acquisition via Google/Facebook ads.
- Full‑service agencies — want one partner for creative, web, ads, analytics and brand.
- B2B demand generation — focus on lead quality, account‑based marketing, and sales alignment.
- E‑commerce specialists — deep knowledge of Shopify/Magento, conversion rate optimization, product feed management.

Typical investment ranges (very approximate)
- Small boutique/freelance: $1k–$5k/month
- Small agency/SMB focus: $3k–$10k/month
- Mid‑sized/full‑service: $8k–$25k+/month
- Project fees (website, audits): $3k–$50k depending on scope

Questions to ask agencies
1. Who will I work with day‑to‑day? Can I meet the team?  
2. Can you show case studies for clients like me? What were the KPIs and results?  
3. How do you track/report ROI and conversions? What tools do you use?  
4. How do you price work and what minimum commitment is required?  
5. What’s your onboarding process and time to first results?  
6. Can you provide client references I can call?

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 4–6 St. Louis agencies tailored to your needs (I’ll need your industry, monthly budget, and top goals), or
- Provide an email/phone template you can use to screen agencies.

Which would you prefer? If you want a shortlist, tell me: industry, monthly marketing budget, top 1–2 goals (e.g., increase organic traffic, lower CAC, grow e‑commerce sales), and whether you need creative/web development.
